unmapped.quote: Do not say collections, debt, payment, or the product name until identity clears — that ban applies even when a relative picks up.
Tell them app or branch; do not state the debt.
A "no" to paying today with neither a date nor an amount is a flat refusal and consumes one try.
First try: propose the last working day of the current week (or of next week if today is already that day), for the full past-due amount — or for the floor if they already rejected the full amount.
Second try (late band only): propose the floor amount on the deadline date.
Do not re-offer a refused option.
Synthetic data only for the build.
